comment: botl.c repad_with_dashes() through wintty.c's hitpointbar. An explore-mode Wizard named "Al  Bo", with two adjacent spaces, takes off her cloak of magic resistance and casts force bolt at herself, leaving 2 of 12 hit points. critically_low_hp() then dashes the bar; repad_with_dashes() replaces the trailing space pairs and stops at the first pair that is not two spaces, so the double space inside the name stays.
